# Time.you

> > A comprehensive global timekeeping platform offering real-time clock, timezone conversion, sunrise/sunset tracking, prayer times, weather, and calendar tools for cities and countries worldwide.

Time.you is a full-featured time and date reference site that combines world clock functionality with environmental and religious data. It serves users seeking accurate timekeeping, timezone coordination, astronomical events, Islamic prayer schedules, air quality monitoring, and weather information across all major cities and countries.

## Key Topics

- Current Time & World Clock
- Timezone Converter
- UTC (Coordinated Universal Time)
- Sunrise & Sunset Times
- Islamic Prayer Times (Salah)
- Global Cities (London, Dubai, NYC, Tokyo, Paris, Sydney)
- Public Holidays & Calendars
- Weather Tracking
- Air Quality Index (AQI)
- Stopwatch & Timer Tools
- Unix Timestamp
- Week Numbers (ISO-8601)
- Atomic Time Sync
- Daylight Hours
- Qibla Direction

## Core Time Tools

- [Your Current Time | Time.you](https://time.you): Time.you homepage: track local time, timezones, and global cities.
- [Online Clock - Exact Digital Time with Seconds](https://time.you/clock): Precise online clock with atomic time sync and customizable themes.
- [Stopwatch - Online, Free & Fullscreen Split Timer | Time.you](https://time.you/stopwatch): Precise online stopwatch with lap splits, fullscreen, CSV export.
- [All Timers | Time.you](https://time.you/timer/all): Directory of countdown timers for seconds, minutes, and hours.

## Global Time & Timezone Reference

- [Time in All Countries | Time.you](https://time.you/countries): Browse current time for all countries worldwide on Time.you.
- [Time in Most Popular Cities | Time.you](https://time.you/cities): View current time for popular cities like NYC, Tokyo, Paris, Dubai.
- [Time in All Time Zones | Time.you](https://time.you/timezones): Reference for all major timezones: EST, PST, UTC, GMT with live times.
- [Time Now in UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) | Time.you](https://time.you/timezones/utc): Current UTC time with timezone offsets and related standards.
- [Current Unix Time Timestamp | Time.you](https://time.you/unix): Live Unix timestamp since epoch (Jan 1, 1970) with explanation.

## Astronomical & Environmental Data

- [Sunrise Times Today | Time.you](https://time.you/sunrise): Live sunrise times and countdowns for cities worldwide.
- [Sunset Times Today | Time.you](https://time.you/sunset): Live sunset times and countdowns for cities worldwide.
- [Sunrise & Sunset Times Today for London, United Kingdom | Time.you](https://time.you/london/sun): Sunrise, sunset, and daylight hours for London with monthly data.
- [World Air Quality Index (AQI) - Live PM2.5 Pollution Map | Time.you](https://time.you/aqi): Real-time air quality index (AQI) and PM2.5 pollution monitoring.
- [Weather Around The World | Time.you](https://time.you/weather): Live weather and temperatures for capital cities worldwide.
- [Weather in London | Time.you](https://time.you/london/weather): Current weather, hourly forecast, and 14-day outlook for London.

## Religious & Cultural Information

- [Islamic Prayer Times Worldwide - Salah Timetables | Time.you](https://time.you/prayer-times): Accurate daily Islamic prayer times (Salah) for worldwide cities.
- [Islamic Prayer Times Today in London, United Kingdom - March 20, 2026 | Time.you](https://time.you/london/prayer-times): Daily Islamic prayer times for London with Qibla direction.

## Calendar & Holiday Reference

- [Calendar 2026 | Time.you](https://time.you/calendar): Printable calendars for 2026 with public holidays worldwide.
- [Public Holidays Worldwide (Next 30 Days) | Time.you](https://time.you/holidays): Global public holidays for today and next 30 days.
- [Week 12, 2026 - Dates and Holidays | Time.you](https://time.you/week-number/2026/12): ISO-8601 week 12 of 2026 with dates and public holidays.
